policy: exact original Qwen3.5-4B G0; qwen_base with schema-only retry, no neural intervention
graph_capture: Every successful original proposal; same original full32 TC/FD/FVU; recorded separately and never used to choose the action
minimum_classes: both labels in every training episode, each fitting fold and pooled independent development

NN.selection: macro held-out-training-episode uncalibrated BCE across three leave-episode-out folds
NN.calibration: one positive scalar temperature from selected-epoch training OOF logits only; logT bounds [-4,4]
NN.final_fit: fresh original seed; all training rows for the selected epoch; no development optimization

development: model/preprocessing/epoch/temperature sealed before development scoring; compare raw and calibrated metrics with training-prior constant
predictive_gate: strictly lower development Brier and NLL than training-prior constant, and AUROC > 0.5; descriptive small-data gate, not significance or policy efficacy
class_or_support_failure: explicit data_insufficient terminal; zero NN fits; no relabeling, retries or automatic data expansion
